But it is four independent config surfaces (fusion_policy, fec_structure_policy + structure_gate_level_permille, fec_loss_risk, fuzzy fixture) governing one output.

TWO rate authorities in the same statement. on_event_core computes natural_rate = compute_send_rate(&decision) (sender.rs:2211) and startup_pacing_floor_bps (sender.rs:2205), then send_rate = natural_rate.max(effective_floor) where effective_floor = floor.min(cwnd_over_srtt()) (sender.rs:2213-2216). FEATURE STATE VERIFIED (crates/adaptive-transport/Cargo.toml:15-27): experimental-fec-budget, experimental-cold-start, diag-sched-telemetry all default OFF and all with empty dependency lists. crates/client-core/Cargo.toml:36-38 enables ONLY diag-sched-telemetry (opt-in). crates/bench/Cargo.toml enables ONLY diag-sched-telemetry. - Transport-level defaults DIFFER from product defaults in three places: FecLossRiskConfig::default() has enabled=false (sender.rs:398) vs product bounded_v1 enabled=true; InitialWindowConfig::default() has bytes=0 = OFF (derive at sender.rs:314) vs product DEFAULT_BURST_CAP; TailRecoveryConfig::default() is OFF (sender.rs:1798) vs product validated_v1() ON (crates/client-core/src/lib.rs:83).

- DR-EST-1 establish probe DEFAULT ON confirmed: sender.rs:1819 establish_probe_enabled: true; only tests ever call set_establish_probe(false).

BENCH-vs-PRODUCT DEFAULT DIVERGENCE (material for any "product arm" claim): crates/bench/src/kama_product.rs builds RuntimeConfig with `..RuntimeConfig::default()` but EXPLICITLY overrides fec_loss_risk with experimental_v1() or default() (:186-221) — grep for bounded_v1 across crates/bench returns ZERO hits. It also passes structure_gate_level_permille straight from the CLI `gate` option (:224), so an unset flag yields None (engine fec_med = 500), not the product's Some(250). The bench "PRODUCT arm" therefore does not exercise the shipped FEC v1 policy unless those flags are set by hand.

SPEC COVERAGE OF THIS SCOPE: specs/adaptive-transport-engine-spec.md covers the state machine (§3, lines 200-262), PRE_CONVERGE cold-start (§3.3, lines 279-376), the CS probe/echo frames (§11.1, lines 801-850, with 0x12 CANCELLED and superseded by 0x19/0x1A), loss detection (§5, 408-467), ack_confidence (§5.1, 468-500), PTO (§12, 868-873), FEC/ARQ fusion (§8.4, 645-679) and the [CAL] constant tables (§16.1/§16.2, 972-1150). It contains NO text for: the Q18 structure gate, the FEC arbiter's max()-of-three rule, the speculative loss-risk lane, LossConfirmHorizon, InitialWindowConfig, StartupPacingConfig/DR-RATE-RAMP-2, tail recovery, or DR-EST-1 (grep over specs/*.md for "structure gate|arbiter|speculative|spekülatif" returns exactly one unrelated hit at line 420). Those seven mechanisms live only in docs/design/* and reports/*, so any v1 claim that leans on them is claiming beyond the frozen spec — and §8.4's own rule (parity_final = min(fuzzy_parity, budget_cap, profile_cap), line 661) is narrower than what fec_arbiter actually does.
